name: helix-constitution
description: Helix Constitution — universal, project-agnostic Claude Code plugins inherited BY REFERENCE by every consuming project (§11.4.28 / §11.4.177). Install with: claude plugin marketplace add ./constitution && claude plugin install helix@helix-constitution

plugins.name: helix
plugins.description: Action directives as native slash commands — every §11.4.140 registered action (BACKGROUND, REMINDER, ISSUE, BUG, TASK, ...) as /<name>, with /helix:<name> as the always-unambiguous escape when a bare name collides with a host built-in. Commands are generated from actions/registry.yaml.

plugins.name: scheduled-work
plugins.description: Scheduled-work / reminder tracking for autonomous agents — records background-queue work items and lets a REMINDER re-verify uncertain/blocked/overdue work before an agent reports it done (§11.4.6 / §11.4.108). Requires the scheduled-work-engine binary: bash plugins/scheduled-work/build.sh
